bugs.what: barrow-wight combat is tedious with low hit rates; evasion option is clearly superior

confusions: Elder's coffer lock-picking option appeared after asking about the crown; unclear if that was a gating mechanic or UI update
Elder's proof requirement for coffer wasn't explicit upfront; had to infer from repeated dialogue that talking to the king was necessary
suggestions: Streamline backtracking between village and barrow (repeating same zones 4-5 times felt tedious)
Make elder's coffer proof requirements clearer in first interaction
Expand reeve/priest faction differentiation - their choices felt thematic but mechanically similar
Add optional shortcuts (e.g., direct path from barrow field to antechamber after first visit)
Combat: either make wight beatable with better odds or make evasion the intended path with combat as risky alternative
